messages.content: Why did Jim reach the glass street before Dorothy and Zeb?
His weight made him descend faster.
Where did the Mangaboo Prince wear the star when he first questioned Zeb?
In his hair, above his forehead.
What sound did Gwig produce when he first waved his hand at the contest?
Tinkling bells.
Why couldn't a Mangaboo lend the Wizard a hat for his trick?
The Mangaboos did not wear hats.
Which two fruits did the visitors find to eat in the Mangaboo gardens?
Strawberries and melons.
What did the piglets nibble when the Wizard set them on the grass?
Tender blades of grass.
Who held up the two lanterns in the glass tunnel while Zeb drove?
Dorothy and the Wizard each held one.
What sound did Zeb imitate to make Jim gallop faster on the way to the mountain?
A bear's growl.
How did Gargoyles communicate without making sounds?
Signals with their fingers or lips.
What did the Wizard take out of his satchel to attach the wings to Jim?
A spool of strong wire.
What size were the dragonettes' heads compared with barrels?
They were as big as barrels.
What did Ozma say the word Oz means in her language?
Great and Good.
What kept the Tin Woodman's heart from getting moldy?
His airtight chest.
What did the Woggle-Bug say H. M. stands for in his title?
Highly Magnified.
Where was the Gump's talking head hung in the palace?
Above the fireplace.
What was attached around the brim of the Munchkin wrestler's hat?
Little bells.
